attempts.summary: Configured VLAN segmentation over the shared eth1 link: node2 tagged into VLAN 10 (10.10.10.0/24), node3 tagged into VLAN 20 (10.10.20.0/24), with node1 (VyOS) acting as router-on-a-stick via 802.1Q sub-interfaces eth1.10 (10.10.10.1/24) and eth1.20 (10.10.20.1/24). Verified with tcpdump that traffic is genuinely 802.1Q-tagged per-VLAN on the shared link and routed through node1 (ttl=63 confirms a routed hop). Config was made persistent (VyOS `save`; Alpine `/etc/network/interfaces` with ifupdown-ng vlan-raw-device + static routes). All three nodes were then restarted one at a time via native `reboot`, each polled back to availability, each showing a changed boot_id, and each verified to have full VLAN/routing functionality restored post-reboot.
